scientific_integrity: A complete combinatorial proof and independent finite consistency checks are supplied. The six-extremizer classification applies to 6|n only. Novelty remains subject to unindexed historical equivalence and independent expert verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem does not enumerate all maximum packings when 6 does not divide n; finite verification alone does not prove the infinite result.
title: Edge-open packings in prism graphs: a six-periodic rigidity theorem
